organizations.name: U.S. Department of Justice
organizations.evidence_claim: The Epstein Files Transparency Act required DOJ to release all unclassified Epstein-related records by Dec. 19, 2025, but by early January DOJ said it was still reviewing more than two million documents and had released only a fraction. Lawmakers and advocates criticized the delay, and the House Oversight Committee voted to hold Bill and Hillary Clinton in contempt for refusing to testify in late January. In court, Ghislaine Maxwell filed a sealed motion to vacate her conviction, prompting orders to redact filings before they are made public.

The plea placed the cover-up at the center of the Russia investigation and raised questions about foreign influence.
